name: manual_1f701f
claim: One host can carry two coordination boards: read every board before claiming or reconciling, and reconcile across boards before acting, or two lanes will duplicate the same task.

decisions.notes: Two clones of the same repository on one host each kept a live board; the orchestrator lane and this session both executed the same audit and repair tasks before the boards were cross-read.

rationale: Two clones of the same repository on one host each kept a live board; the orchestrator lane and this session both executed the same audit and repair tasks before the boards were cross-read.
